## Pull Request Description

### Summary of Changes
Provide a brief overview of what this pull request introduces or fixes.

### Related Issue / Change Request
- Closes #[Issue Number]
- Implements CR: [e.g. CR-01, CR-02]
- Traceability Ref: [e.g. FR-09, CI-03]

### Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] CI/CD pipeline adjustment

### Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the code style and guidelines of this project.
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code.
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas.
- [ ] I have added unit and integration tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works.
- [ ] New and existing tests pass locally (`mvn test` and `npm test`).
- [ ] Static analysis passes with zero warnings (`npm run lint`).
- [ ] Production build succeeds (`npm run build`).
- [ ] End-to-end smoke test passes (`tests/smoke.ps1` or `tests/smoke.sh`).
